jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(H) inventory: Weathersfield School District, a town school district in the Windsor Southeast Supervisory Union (member town: Weathersfield). Operates K-8; tuitions grades 9-12.

board.post_note: Weathersfield SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by ballot at the annual meeting.

sources.note: Windsor Southeast SU Weathersfield School Board page (official, fetched 2026-10-22; names/years recovered from the page's embedded data -- the rendered-text fetch drops them): Steele (Chair) 2027, Redmond (Vice Chair) 2028, Arrison (Clerk) 2027, Jewell 2027, Waite 2029. Corroborated for Arrison by the SU's Sept. 2026 Act 170 page (each district names its own representative from its board). FLAG: three members ending 2027 is an irregular stagger the fetched sources do not explain (one or more may hold remainder terms) -- the ends are minted AS PUBLISHED; resolving document: the district's annual report / March 3, 2026 warning and results. The section 423(b) size vote was not fetched; size rests on the SU's five-member roster. (Universe-frame correction: the parent SU is Windsor Southeast per section 603(a)(5)(H), not Windham Northeast.)
